native_semantic_adaptations: Complete native counterpart of an originally commented source Notebook: six position bits and coin, exact original control/shift semantics, actual target-basis resource counts, observed local durations, named readout, independent Circuit full-state and all128-column checks. The source calls Tket box decomposition, synthesis and an Aer backend. We report actual FlagQuantum CX/U3 costs instead of claiming the unspecified Aer/Tket basis or private pass equivalence. The source shift is modular increment. Coin=1 applies increment; coin=0 applies its inverse. The logical value is six-bit unsigned, with source array index zero as the low bit. CX/U3. U3 is the three-angle U gate. All explicit conversion rules preserve absolute phase.
